title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cherry from Elfliq’s range of nic salt e-liquids is a deliciously sweet and juicy cherry candy flavour. Deep and succulent, the burst of fruit chased by the sugary sweetness of tangy cherry candy makes for a truly irresistible taste sensation and an easy and uplifting all-day vape. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
